name: Cinturato EVO TLR

origin.basis: Italian tire maker; Pirelli says the P ZERO Race range is made at its plant in Italy near its Milan headquarters.

manufacturing.basis: The product page does not state where this tire is made.

positioning: Pirelli's tubeless-ready all-weather endurance tire with the SmartEVO AS compound and a reinforced 60 TPI TechWALL+ Road casing.

wet_notes.summary: Pirelli says it is designed to excel in all weather and road conditions with the SmartEVO AS compound; no independent wet test found.

availability.note: Listed in Pirelli's global road range on 2026-11-01; regional retail not checked.

caveats: Also sold in 55 mm (710 g), outside this comparison.
Pressure limits and hookless compatibility are not stated in the captured page.
Wet performance is a maker claim; no independent wet test found.

image.shown: Full view of the Cinturato EVO TLR from Pirelli's catalogue; one photo covers every width.
image.alt: Pirelli Cinturato EVO TLR tire shown as a full ring

rights.usage_note: The maker's own product photo, shown from the maker's website; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Coded on 2026-11-03 from a fixed source set: the written reviews on the Sigma Sports and bike-components product pages, read in full through each page's own review list in a browser (the newest 15 per page when more exist), every reader comment on Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test pages for this tire, and owner comments in coded Xiaohongshu threads. Counted only owners who describe their own riding; star-only ratings, mounting-only impressions and repeats were left out. Corrected on 2026-11-03: the 40 mm test page's reader comments are now read as well.

reports.summary: Very hard to fit, then felt slow, numb and heavy-steering compared with the owner's Vittoria Corsa Pro; no puncture, but the owner sold them and cannot recommend them.
Performed at a very high level over the first 100 miles.

checks.note: Two of 4 written reviews never got the tire mounted
Nine comments on the 28 and 40 mm test pages, none first-hand
